caption:
Stress does not just feel bad. It quietly turns down the part of your brain you think with.

Prolonged stress reduces activity in the prefrontal cortex, the region that handles focus, planning and holding things in mind. That is why fog, forgetfulness and low mood tend to arrive together rather than separately. These changes are real, and they tend to ease as the load comes down.
